summary: VSee Health, Inc. filed an 8-K to ratify August 25, 2026 as the date of its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders and July 6, 2026 as the record date. The filing establishes deadlines for stockholder proposals under Rule 14a-8 and universal proxy rules, requiring notice by July 17, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or activist campaign is announced. This is a routine administrative update about meeting logistics and shareholder proposal deadlines. There are no deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation disclosed. What to watch: monitor any shareholder proposals submitted by the deadline.
